# kinde_user_feature_flags (Resource)

Overrides feature flag values for a user. Kinde only accepts user overrides for flags whose `allow_override_level` is `usr`. **Kinde has no API to remove a user override:** removing a flag from `flags` or destroying this resource only stops Terraform managing it, and the override keeps its last value in Kinde until it is changed there. See [documentation](https://docs.kinde.com/kinde-apis/management/#tag/users) for more details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kinde_feature_flag" "max_projects" {
  key                  = "max_projects"
  name                 = "Max projects"
  type                 = "int"
  allow_override_level = "usr"
  default_value        = "3"
}

resource "kinde_user_feature_flags" "jane" {
  user_id = "kp_1234567890abcdef"
  flags = {
    (kinde_feature_flag.max_projects.key) = "10"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flags` (Map of String) Override values keyed by feature flag key. Values are strings in the form Kinde returns them, e.g. `"true"` or `"false"` for boolean flags and `"42"` for integer flags. The flags must already exist.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The `user_id`.
